description: The 0.5.0 retrospective (2026-11-05) found that a blocking full-matrix release UAT was added by coverage, never calibrated on hosted runners, and that process machinery (oracle, release workflow) shipped without live execution. The owner decided on 2026-11-05: (1) continuous UAT on trunk, nightly at 02:00 UTC and skipped when nothing relevant changed; a release checks evidence instead of running UAT, with full UAT only as a fallback. This supersedes the 2026-10-28 decision 'no reduction of UAT or gate coverage' and the 'artifact-bound release UAT' requirement in docs/internal/release-artifacts.md. (2) A standing release-window freeze: no infrastructure, oracle or CI-machinery merges between an rc tag and its PyPI publish. (3) New guardrail G12, calibrate before block: a new blocking gate needs a hosted calibration run, a measured runtime, a runner budget and a statement of what it catches. (4) The agent gate-tuning rubric (image digest pins; one recorded automatic retry for infrastructure signatures; envelope moves only above 20% infrastructure-failure rate over the last 10 runs, with another scale of the same platform x benchmark still gated, evidence cited and a tracker item filed; never a timeout, memory-limit or validation change). (5) Theseus/oracle is consumed as a pinned dependency: bumps go through a canary PR set and a fail-closed posting check, rollback is reverting the pin, and nothing changes during a release window. (6) Release-v2 probe mode and fail-closed detectors are required. This item writes these decisions into docs/internal/adr/adr-dev-loop-v2.md (new decision-log entry plus G12 and the freeze rule in the guardrail list) and updates release-artifacts.md and release-guide.md to the evidence-check model. Docs only.
